'''Stage I Beckons''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed in the [[:Category:Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier. Killing one will grant the {{AdvancementLink|Gardener}}.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned by the [[Reinforcement System]]:
**Spawned randomly upon the death of Parasites larger than 1 block.
**Spawned randomly on [[Residue]].
**Spawned on [[Infested Blocks]], created by other Beckons.
*Spawned by [[Stage IV Beckon|Stage IV Beckons]].
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Stage II Beckon]] is killed.
Stage I Beckons will not spawn if there are already 2 other Beckons in the same chunk.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Stage I Beckons are Stationary Block Infesters and Defensive Support parasites.

*Stage I Beckons are capable of spawning [[Rupter|Rupters]], through the usage of [[Biomass]]. [[Stage I Beckon#Summoning and Mobs Value|More info below]].
*They're able to convert blocks, depending on their [[Hardness]]<ref>Max [[Hardness]] of the Blocks they can infest, by default, is 4.5. </ref>, to their [[Infested Blocks|Infested Variant]], these include Infested Dirt, Stone and Wood. The Infestation can spread in a 4 block radius with a 60 second minimum Infestation cooldown per block radius.
**The same Infested Blocks can generate more Stage I Beckons, extending the range of the Infested Zone. There can be a maximum of 2 Beckons per Chunk.

* Stage I Beckons throw 2 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. The bombs inflict 2.5 damage each and place an effect cloud of stacking [[Viral]] and Poison.
* Stage I Beckons can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 3, with a 60 ticks cooldown and 1 Block range.

=== ''Summoning'' ===
Stage I Beckons are capable of spawning various [[Mobs]], through the usage of [[Biomass]].

The summoning Ability is based on Points. Each Mob has a certain Points value. Spawned Parasites will either be sorted by Ground type or Air, Parasites categorized as Air type will be spawned instead of Grounded if the target is 3 blocks above the summoner.

'''Stage I Beckons have a total of 4 Points per summon and can summon 4 mobs before its cooldown of 10 seconds with a cap of 4 parasites active at once.'''

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Stage I Beckons, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
*Stage I Beckons will take damage over time and die if the current dimension is [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] or lower.
=== ''Post-Death'' ===
Stage I Beckons, after being killed, will clean all the Infested Blocks it created, turning them into [https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Gravel gravel] with Residue on top.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Like all Nexuses, Stage I Beckons do not despawn by default.
*Beckons are known as '''Venkrol''' internally. The etymology or meaning of this is unknown.
*Despite their floral shape, Beckons and Dispatchers are not related to plants, as they're the same kind of pseudo-arthropod as Inborns and Pures. Additionally, Beckons' biomass pods are not eggs, though they serve a similar function.
*Beckons use [[Biomass]] chunks to spawn other [[Mobs|Parasites]].
*All Beckons except for Stage IV have fleshy "roots" below their model. They use these roots to infest blocks, absorb energy and biomass from [[the Source]], and evolve.
*Like Dispatchers and Rooters, Beckons are physical appendages of the Source sent from underground.
